title: app-shell: the full-page record form (/new, /edit route) still toasts "Task updated successfully" — #26172's fix covered AppContent's dialog paths only; RecordFormPage passes the object label alone
body:
Filing gate: ① a product defect, measured live and confirmed in source. It is the incomplete half of closed #26172 (PR #26202), found beside the clauses of a QA run.
Business reason: ruling C on #25849 (comment 6417978207) says a record create or update toast names the record by its title. #26172's acceptance reads "Creating and editing a record that has a title shows a toast naming that title". The dialog paths now do this ('Task "WF Create E3" created'), but a user who edits on the full-page form route still sees "Task updated successfully".
Reader: the `domain:ui` owner of `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordFormPage.tsx`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): #26172 (closed, completed). Its premises P2 and P3 name only `AppContent.tsx:816–817 / 842–843`, and `RecordFormPage.tsx` is not mentioned there. No open card covers the page route.
reach: console page route `/_console/apps/APP/OBJECT/record/ID/edit` (and `/new`). Measured on a fresh stock showcase boot at `756220c4` as admin; the console was built in-repo from `ui/` at that commit.
Checklist item priority: P1
type: Bug
QA-source: #26456 · ux-conventions.write-feedback · observed beside the clauses

## Reproduction
1. Boot the stock showcase and sign in as admin.
2. Open a task on its full-page edit route, reached by in-app navigation (a cold page load of `/edit` makes save's `navigate(-1)` leave the document and drops the toast).
3. Change the title and Save. A PATCH answers 200.
4. The toast reads **"Task updated successfully"**.

For contrast, the dialog create on the list reads `Task "WF Create E3" created`.

**Expected:** `Task "NEW TITLE" updated` (or the object-label fallback only when no display name resolves).

## Mechanism
`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordFormPage.tsx:162–163` calls `t('form.createSuccess', { object: label })` / `t('form.updateSuccess', { object: label })` with no record title. `AppContent.tsx:846/850` were changed by #26202; this call site was not. The page has the saved record in hand at that point, so it can pass the display name the same way.
